requirements.statement: live collaboration, presence, conflict, and recovery postconditions remain exact across every retained executable selector and declared fixture/runtime boundary.

Collaboration bounds intent payloads, replay events and bytes, retention, retry, and subscriber buffering; sequences incidents independently; quarantines rather than skips unrecoverable incident work; and exposes safe queue, lag, reset, quarantine, pruning, and slow-consumer telemetry.

Collaboration durably sequences every admitted replayable event family per incident from transaction-coupled intents, preserves monotonic replay across restart, stores resume tokens only by hash, and rechecks current authorization before replay or live delivery.

Every replayable event is produced by exactly one code-backed source-owner producer in the authoritative transaction; exact duplicate intents are immutable no-ops, divergent reuse fails the transaction, and database triggers are not behavior fallbacks.
